references.observations: Bank-level profile shows the lower chord deepening at the two piers and the repeating green diagonal web.
Lower side view shows slender verticals, the main and side span depth profiles and pier caps.
Oblique aerial shows the tapered shafts, footing steps, separated deck and green rail screen.
Placer County describes a crossing nearly half a mile long and about 730 ft above the river. This contextual height is distinct from the sampled render clearance.
